horoscopes.horoscope: You’ve finally realised that diet and exercise are a must, and you especially need to take good care. Today, you may wish to eat something different. Tried Mongolian cuisine? Ganesha suggests that you go out with some friends who you’ve not been paying attention to. Lack of emotional control may spoil the harmony of your love life and you may not get peace of mind. If you disagree with your partner, it’s your responsibility to turn it to a win-win situation. You need to overcome your emotions before it controls you, advises Ganesha. You may not be in a mood to take much overload today. You are actually not in your full form. You will need to take help of others in order to finish off your important tasks as you are likely to feel more tired. There is no chance to earn an extra buck through any source other that your primary job or business. Besides, you will not even have the desire to put in extra efforts, as you just wish to unwind. Do whatever it takes to keep yourself calm because unbridled passion will govern your actions today, foresees Ganesha. You will feel competitive inside and your desire to covet the best projects will make you go green with envy when someone else will be assigned your tasks.

There is a strong possibility of receptivity and sensitivity in your love life. On the down side, your negativity may lead to mediocre results. You are a fire-fighter when it comes to others’ problems, but can forget digging a well for your own home, says Ganesha. Make travel plans with your loved one. If that isn’t possible, then spend some quality time far away from mundane life. A visit in a rural area with your spouse will give you emotional comfort and romantic pleasure, feels Ganesha. Capture some beautiful moments together will strengthen your bond with loved one. You will be in good health today. Besides, you may also need to take necessary actions on pending tasks. You could get closer to people whom you like which may further have a positive impact on your health. Avoid taking heavy workload. Ganesha feels that you will remain satisfied with what you are earning, which will also give you peace of mind. Investing too much effort or time in anything else is not likely to benefit you. Your wit and creativity will impress your boss today. Good news that the routine tasks will bore you and you will try to be innovative in your projects. Ganesha advises you to understand the intricacies of any task so that you can master it easily.

Some of your personal belongings are very dear to you. You may have to grudgingly share them with someone else. A mild pang of jealousy may kick in. But, you are merely being protective of something very personal, so there is nothing wrong with that, says Ganesha. The romantic and mushy conversation you will have with your partner will help you reach a new level of a platonic relationship and Ganesha isn’t hinting at physical proximity. Music will surely play a great mood to get closer to your loved one, says Ganesha. Today your mood is going to swing upwards and your fitness level is bound to zoom. Needless to say, you shall quickly and swiftly complete your tasks in all the spheres. This will surprise your seniors and elders says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that you are going to have chance to earn more money today. You will come across opportunities to get more business, find a new job or negotiate your salary to get a better deal. If you deal with any technical task today, it’s better to postpone it as today’s astral configuration may confound you and you may remain stuck in the labyrinth. You are advised to find a comfortable task that you will be in a great mood to accomplish with a sheer perfection.

You will be in high spirits today, foretells Ganesha. It is a favourable day to engage in household activities, like gardening, cooking or even washing laundry. In the evening, work will be eclipsed by the pleasures of love. Today, you are ready to do anything and everything for the one you love. You will be overwhelmed by emotion and care your beloved will shower on you. Your loving and caring attitude will work extremely well with your sweetheart, says Ganesha. You are likely to maintain good physical fitness today. However, as far as your temperament is concerned, you may become very sentimental and thus feel low. Control yourself, else it may have a detrimental effect on your health, says Ganesha. Today you are likely to remain sensitive about money matters. You stand a chance to get carried away by other people’s guidelines. You need to be practical and avoid being taken ride for. A great start to a great day! Your presentation skills will put the spotlight on you. Opt for the projects that involve technology. A helping hand from a colleague and a pat from your boss for a job well done will make your day, says Ganesha.

Time is one thing that you have in short change today, says Ganesha. There is every possibility that you shall remain extremely busy. The tasks may be small — like writing a letter to revive old contacts — but it is important that you do them. Chances are that you may also end up giving a few interviews over the phone. Just remember that your ability to make things work and do your best make you the prime candidate for organising and conducting urgent meetings. In short, buckle up as Ganesha predicts a busy day. God is testing your mindset under difficulties as the cosmic undercurrents say that you may have to go through some adverse situation. Patience and tolerance will help you deal with differences of opinion with your partner. You need to understand your partner’s feelings, says Ganesha. This day may be less favourable from the health point of view. Those who are middle-aged and above should take the necessary precautions to avoid complications in future, advises Ganesha. Do some yoga exercises to improve your fitness level. The one who is Royal doesn’t believe in buying anything mediocre. Today, you are going to spend money like water, to maintain your royal lifestyle. You may wish to put in extra money in existing house, vehicle. Remember half knowledge is more dangerous than no knowledge at all. This applies to you at your office today, warns Ganesha. If you don’t be circumspect, you may find yourself slogging throughout the day. There take precautions and get prepared to be fully aware of the working situation, suggests Ganesha.

Family matters will matter today. They hold more weight in your thoughts than everything else, says Ganesha. Business will be good today. Spend the evening relaxing and chilling out. On the cards is a visit to a place of worship. You will be obedient to your sweetheart and will follow his/her instruction carefully. You will be ready to do whatever he/she demands. Your loving and caring attitude will delight your partner in such a way that will make a perfect recipe for a romantic life. Look forward to a enthusiastic and energetic day. However, some minor issues on the domestic as well as professional front may cause some anxiety. To overcome such situations, you need to remain composed. Also think pragmatically and logically, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that today you will be dealing with your finances very smartly. You will not spend blindly on things that you are willing to buy or even on things that you ‘have to’ buy. You should be grateful to the positive aura that has been surrounding you and will keep you in an optimistic frame of mind. This promises healthy relationship with co-workers. This positive energy shall help you enjoy a pleasant evening, feels Ganesha.

Your concern for your family surmounts all else, that much Ganesha knows. Today, you will fulfil your filial duties in all that you undertake. As Ganesha rightly points out: All good things begin at home, including your fortune and good luck. You may expect a lot from someone you are in love. After all, it is not possible to get everything from your sweetheart. The adjustment will be the key to relationship bliss. Therefore, it will be wiser if you avoid getting too demanding in matters of the heart, says Ganesha. Be prepared to do multiple tasks on this very hectic day. Anyway, you will easily and swiftly accomplish your tasks. Moreover, you shall not get exhausted in the evening. Expend rest of your time and energy for loved ones, says Ganesha. It is a very good day to focus on your career which will help bring more money in your pocket. Ganesha feels this is a very favourable day to learn about new ways and means to increase your financial strength. Your creative inputs will be getting brilliant day by day and will result in maximizing benefits. You will be able to glide smoothly into the good books of your colleagues and superiors today. Ganesha thinks this will be very beneficial for you in the long run. Ganesha’s heartiest congratulations to you.

A healthy and hectic day is in store for you today. You are likely to finish your pending tasks with new zeal. But the chaotic day will blossom into a fabulous evening when you hang out with your sweetheart, says Ganesha. You may feel the need to spend quality time with your loved one and may hence plan a leisure trip. You may select a darker place where you want to fill your sweetheart with pleasure. A cruise ship or an underwater destination would be an ideal place for you to spend a passionate time. On this vibrant day, you will be feeling full of beans. As a result, things which appear to be difficult for others, you shall find it easy. Ganesha therefore advises you to just go ahead and attend all tough tasks. You will be lucky in money matters. Your decisions regarding finances will be very firm and you will not like to change them, once taken. Today you will be straightforward and very clear in money matters. With your stars shining very bright, you will enjoy this rather lovely day. At the workplace, your colleagues will agree with your ideas. You may be quite impractical. Try to see the broader picture with an eye for practical details, says Ganesha.

Be set to capture the flag and sing the victory song in whatever task you take up today. Your subordinates will be the ones needing your support and motivation. At the end of the day, the icing on the cake would be the smile you take to bed. Ganesha foresees that you may try to advise your sweetheart if a certain thing doesn’t work in his/her favour. You will expect nothing in return and take solace in giving. You will realise that the joy of giving is more satisfying than that of receiving. Take good care of your health today as it is not a good day from health point of view. You may feel dull and down today. There will be sudden change in your energy level. You will not be very comfortable handling things. Ganesha advises to be calm and composed about your financial situation and hope for the improvement in the future. Until you start building your saving reserves you will not find peace. A task that has been pending for too long will call your immediate attention today. However, avoid burning the midnight oil, else you may harm your health, suggests Ganesha. You should not force your boss in the meeting room. It’s diplomacy which will help you handle emotional matters.

The achievements of the day may make you feel like you were born to succeed in life. Yes, you will be successful in whatever you do today, even if you don’t try too hard for it, says Ganesha. But it’s important that you at least take an initiative and not expect rewards to come for no reason. Make the most of the day for fortune may not be as favourable tomorrow. Your friends and those you socialise with will praise you for your sterling quality and powerful personality. You’ll be rather emotional when you meet your partner today, and renew your vows of commitment and love. You fear that you will lose your sweetheart. Therefore, you will feel loyal and committed to your partner and tend to be happy and satisfied in the relationship. As you may not be energetic today, you should deal with things that can give you feeling of accomplishment and must not get involved in thankless tasks. Ganesha also feels that you should seek other people’s help in case you can’t deal with something. The stars are not too auspicious for you on the financial front today. Income is unlikely to receiving a boost. This is a good day to expand your contacts base, as they can be handy in the future. A slightly stressful day for you, says Ganesha. This emotional stress can force you to act aggressively. You may not allow anyone to take the lead in office, and if someone argues or tries to overtake, chances are you may lose your temper.

You will prove yourself today by staying ahead of your rivals in all ways. You will conquer your frustrations, and will soon be raring to go. Your pleasing demeanour endears you to others and you win admiration from all quarters, says Ganesha. Love will give you laugh, love will give you pain, Love will teach you a lesson, love will bring the rain. Your emotional life will depend on the way you treat your loved one. You will be happy to dive into the world full of pleasure and luxury only if you pay attention to your love life. You will see the end result will definitely be helpful. “ Ganesha foresees that you are likely to remain preoccupied with lots of work in the professional as well as personal sphere today. As a result, your energy levels may dip by the end of the day. Just relax in the evening. The day indicates routine expenses and routine income. No major ups and downs are foreseen on the financial front. If you have taken loans in the past, you should repaying them at the earliest. Bravo! You will be able to finish all your work at a jet speed today. You won’t even mind spending some extra hours at the workplace. Of course, hard work will pay off handsomely, assures Ganesha. Hard work with smart efforts will smoothen your work, feels Ganesha.

You probably jumped out of bed this morning itching to talk to someone. And why not, since all your latent power of expression will spring out like a jack-in-the-box today. The pearls of wisdom you shower on people who are down-in-the-dumps today will make them feel good about their bluesy, taciturn selves, says Ganesha. If you are a single, a scintillating someone may attract you today. Ganesha promises a great time for those who are already in love. A great romantic life is on the cards. You may indulge in over-imagining the brighter future of life. You will have good level of energy and potential for creativity today. However, you should use you should use this energy positively in some creative manner. This is the right day to have more of fruit juices or any other liquids that you like. Ganesha feels that today you are likely to spend money recklessly on hedonistic pleasures. It will be important for you to feel happy in your heart and money will only be secondary. Today, you will amaze everyone with your cheerful mood. This will certainly improve your productivity. You may take part in learn-fun-earn activities. With colleagues, you will enjoy a healthy exchange of ideas and this mutual give-and-take will improve your interpersonal skills, feels Ganesha.
